<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def blocks_map(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    pts = {}
    for r in range(len(rows)):
        for c in range(len(rows[r])):
            ch = rows[r][c]
            if ch in 'wSbYpg':
                pts[(r,c)] = ch
    # group into 2x2 blocks by top-left
    out = {}
    used = set()
    for (r,c),ch in sorted(pts.items()):
        if (r,c) in used: continue
        if (r+1,c) in pts and (r,c+1) in pts and (r+1,c+1) in pts and pts[(r+1,c)]==ch and pts[(r,c+1)]==ch and pts[(r+1,c+1)]==ch:
            out[(r,c)] = ch
            for dr in (0,1):
                for dc in (0,1): used.add((r+dr,c+dc))
    return out
before = blocks_map(current_frame)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':14}], intent='explore')
after = blocks_map(current_frame)
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','no_impact')})
print('before n=',len(before),'after n=',len(after))
for k in sorted(set(before)|set(after)):
    if before.get(k)!=after.get(k):
        print(k, before.get(k,'-'),'->',after.get(k,'-'))
</parameter>
</function>

- Level 2: a 10×10 lattice of 2×2 block slots (rows/cols 17..44 step 3). 42 blocks form three horizontal bands (rows 0–2 arch, row 3 full + stubs, row 6 full + stubs, row 9 arch-bottom). sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def blocks_map(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    pts = {}
    for r in range(len(rows)):
        for c in range(len(rows[r])):
            ch = rows[r][c]
            if ch in 'wSbYpg':
                pts[(r,c)] = ch
    # group into 2x2 blocks by top-left
    out = {}
    used = set()
    for (r,c),ch in sorted(pts.items()):
        if (r,c) in used: continue
        if (r+1,c) in pts and (r,c+1) in pts and (r+1,c+1) in pts and pts[(r+1,c)]==ch and pts[(r,c+1)]==ch and pts[(r+1,c+1)]==ch:
            out[(r,c)] = ch
            for dr in (0,1):
                for dc in (0,1): used.add((r+dr,c+dc))
    return out
before = blocks_map(current_frame)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':14}], intent='explore')
after = blocks_map(current_frame)
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','no_impact')})
print('before n=',len(before),'after n=',len(after))
for k in sorted(set(before)|set(after)):
    if before.get(k)!=after.get(k):
        print(k, before.get(k,'-'),'->',after.get(k,'-'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
